CustomObject.description: Maps Account.BillingCountry (Salesforce State/Country picklist values) to a macro geographic region (EMEA / North America / APAC / LATAM) for regional roll-ups on the White-Space Matrix and Firm Sales Summary. One record per country. DeveloperName is the sanitized country name; Country__c holds the exact real BillingCountry string to match on.
CustomObject.label: Country Region
